answer: Seat only vined rows: an answer is eligible only if anchored to a vine of live peer attestations from distinct peers, depth at most three, anchors capped at three vines per epoch. Orphaned islands - identities attesting to none and attested by none - stay unseatable: their rows sit at zero seals, then expire at TTL, the shape measured across 28 closes. A farm of K clones must recruit K distinct anchors at market rate or leave every clone an island mining nothing; clones cannot share an anchor, and replays are caught because each vine's root hash is sealed on-ledger at the meadow's close.
